needs.title: GOV.UK: learning about user needs
needs.finding: Research people's contexts, constraints and goals; test assumptions
needs.limitation: Does not prescribe this portfolio or validate its synthetic profiles

assisted.title: GOV.UK: understanding users who do not use digital services
assisted.finding: Account for barriers to digital access and assisted routes
assisted.limitation: Specific needs still require project research

inclusive.title: Microsoft Inclusive Design
inclusive.finding: Learn from exclusion; an improvement for one constrained user can benefit others
inclusive.limitation: Not an accessibility certification or a validated persona

predictable.title: W3C WCAG: predictable interaction
predictable.finding: Keep navigation and behavior predictable and avoid unexpected context changes
predictable.limitation: Conformance requires checking applicable criteria in the actual UI

hax.title: Microsoft human-AI interaction guidelines
hax.finding: Explain AI capabilities and limits, support correction and user control
hax.limitation: Project-specific risks and user preferences need validation

a2a.title: A2A v1.0.1 enterprise guidance
a2a.finding: Separate advertised authentication, actual credentials and application authorization
a2a.limitation: Optional protocol guidance, not a required SDK or supplied authorization

doherty.title: Laws of UX: Doherty Threshold
doherty.finding: Timely useful feedback around 400 milliseconds can preserve interactive flow
doherty.limitation: Modern UX summary; not proof of response time, nor a full AI-answer deadline

diataxis.title: Diataxis documentation framework
diataxis.finding: Separate tutorials, how-to guidance, explanation and reference for distinct needs
diataxis.limitation: A small PoC may combine views without duplicating facts

speckit.title: Spec-Kit workflow reference
speckit.finding: Workflows can record stage progress, gates and explicit resumption
speckit.limitation: Actual cumulative invocation must be verified against the pinned release/integration; this portfolio does not implement it

claude-permissions.title: Claude non-interactive permission handling
claude-permissions.finding: Non-interactive execution retains permission controls and can report denied tools
claude-permissions.limitation: A permission mode is not an OS sandbox or authority for external effects

claude-rules.title: Claude fine-grained permission rules
claude-rules.finding: Review exact commands and grant narrow rules rather than general shell access
claude-rules.limitation: Actual command matching and managed policy must be checked in the installed release

claude-settings.title: Claude project-local settings
claude-settings.finding: Project-local settings can keep personal permissions out of shared configuration
claude-settings.limitation: Settings precedence and repository/worktree placement remain environment-dependent

codex-config.title: Codex configuration reference
codex-config.finding: Model and reasoning choices can be selected explicitly for a native invocation
codex-config.limitation: Actual model/effort availability depends on the account and installed client

codex-exec.title: Codex native exec reference
codex-exec.finding: Non-interactive execution supports per-run configuration and structured final output
codex-exec.limitation: Structured output alone does not prove semantic completion; normal permissions remain

accessibility.title: W3C WCAG 2.2
accessibility.finding: Check keyboard/focus, contrast, readable labels and meaningful error/status feedback
accessibility.limitation: Targeted PoC checks do not establish full conformance

tagging.title: Git: tagging
tagging.finding: Use annotated tags for meaningful source checkpoints and explicitly push selected tags
tagging.limitation: A checkpoint is not release/publication authority or a budget-compliance claim

marimo.title: Marimo documentation
marimo.finding: Optional reactive Python presentation can import a reusable application core
marimo.limitation: Reactivity is not action authorization; notebook isolation is not an OS security sandbox
